title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：picnic　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 picnic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the cook ① had the picnic that no guest in the canteen would have recorded, and he said the having was the whole of the day. The ② picnic, meaning the meal itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; a picnic, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ picnic in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ picnic at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A picnic, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cook said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the picnic was the whole of the matter, meaning the pleasure and not the meal. The ⑥ picnic, meaning the pleasure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; picnic, he said, is either something you have or the only word that means both a meal and a pleasure. He said the pleasure is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ picnic had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ picnic of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of recording; picnic, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ picnic I remember is the meal recorded in the menu, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the canteen. A ⑩ picnic, my mother said in 2003, is the only meal that improves by being recorded; every picnic, she said, is a pleasure that has agreed to look like a meal. She said the pleasure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 野餐（指食堂里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 野餐（指那次野餐本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：have the picnic 办这一次野餐
D. n. 野餐（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 野餐之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的野餐之事）
F. n. 野餐（指菜单里写到、被记载的那一次）
G. n. 野餐、野趣（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 野趣（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: had the picnic that no guest in the canteen would have recorded
The picnic, meaning the meal itself and not the bowl
the picnic at the far table
the picnic was the whole of the matter
the picnic had become a line in a menu
The picnic of the whole thing
A picnic, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: have the picnic 意为“办这一次野餐”，1994 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯记载的一次野餐做了一遍。
picnic 意为“野餐”，指那次野餐本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。
picnic 意为“野餐”，指食堂里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
picnic 意为“野餐”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
picnic 意为“野餐、野趣”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次野趣就是那件事的全部。
picnic 意为“野趣”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次野餐，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
picnic 意为“野餐”，指菜单里写到、被记载的那一次，到 1999 年这一次成了菜单里的一行。
picnic 意为“野餐之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的野餐之事是一处食堂和三个日子的记载。
picnic 意为“野餐”，我记得的是菜单里记载过的那一次，2001 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一次。
picnic 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，野餐是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的野餐。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

那次野餐，指的是那次野餐本身而不是小小的碗，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。（picnic）
那处食堂里每一次野餐旁边都有同一只小小的碗。（picnic）
最远那张桌角那次野餐，指的是他们留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（picnic）
叔叔说这次野趣就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那次野餐。（picnic）
2003 年母亲说，野餐是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的野餐。（picnic）
